mechanism: Diclofenac inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing modafinil exposure, while modafinil induces CYP3A4, creating bidirectional metabolic interaction; NSAIDs may increase cardiovascular risk when combined with stimulants.
action: Monitor for modafinil toxicity signs (headache, insomnia, tachycardia); consider alternative analgesic or adjust modafinil dosing; assess cardiovascular status given combined stimulant and NSAID use.
